title: Performance step 2, phase A: one entry per measurable fix
derivedFrom: First-parent history 916c9ab..191a1cd (merges 17ba69a A2, 297c108 A3, c34a3d6 A4, ca237b3 A1, d0f30c2 A5, 92c10a4 A6; every package branch starts at 916c9ab), the builders' commit bodies (finding ids, fixup-of trailers, expected effects) and trial builds with tools/New-PerfBuild.ps1 for the requires lists.

baseline.note: Review baseline. Its Skins tree is identical to 71bfcdc (0.1.0-alpha.6 plus the WebNowPlaying placeholder fix), which the review names; 916c9ab adds the measurement tools that each build runs.

all.note: All of phase A, as measured in the review's "Phase A result". Its Skins tree equals the last merge 92c10a4 and 191a1cd; later commits on that line are docs only.

scope.note: Builds apply only runtime files: Skins/, without the test, QA and validator files that tools/Stage-Parallax.ps1 never stages. Docs and tools stay as the start commit has them, so every build runs the same measuring tools. Excluding the tests also keeps single-fix picks free of test-file conflicts that have nothing to do with runtime.

fields.commits: Applied in this order. role fix = the change; fixup = a later review correction of that change (fixup-of trailer).
fields.requires: Earlier fixes this fix needs: it does not apply without them (textual) or does not work without them (functional). New-PerfBuild refuses a unit without them unless -IncludeRequired, and refuses all-minus-a-unit while other fixes still require it unless -IncludeDependents.
fields.revertWith: Later fixes that must leave together with this one when it is reverted from the all tip, beyond those that require it (revert direction only).
fields.isolatedScenarios: Benchmark-Parallax.ps1 scenarios where the fix can show; empty when the isolated benchmark cannot see it.
fields.isolatedEffect: expected = visible in a standard isolated window; live-only = needs the live trace; load = load or refresh time only; interactive = settings clicks only; after-fill = acts only minutes after load, beyond a standard window. Invoke-PerfMatrix.ps1 treats an unmeasured unit whose fixes are all non-expected as zero, and says so.
fields.kind: fix, or honesty for a runtime change made for honest state rather than performance.
fields.support: Commits with no runtime file inside the scope (tests, docs). policy excluded: never applied by a pick build (the scope drops them); a tip build contains them unchanged. Neither affects anything measured.
fields.units: Suggested step-3 units: every fix alone unless requires/revertWith tie it to others, in which case the tied fixes form one unit. They partition the fixes, so plus and minus builds need no -IncludeRequired or -IncludeDependents and sum(g) is well defined. isolated false: no fix in the unit can show in the isolated benchmark.
